label: own benchmark PDF, #20668 on efefad3
why: #20668 replaces the two Planner/spec PDFs that we do not own with soknad-digitaliseringstilskudd.pdf, which we made from the HTML file beside it in benchmarks/assets. Planner/spec has one item, spec-digitaliseringstilskudd, in place of spec-ki-sandkasse and spec-helseattest. In Benchmarks/forms, digitaliseringstilskudd-flere-sider replaces helseattest-barnehage. It sends the same PDF with the goal "Lag det vedlagte skjemaet", without the component types that the old goal listed. The labels and the rubric come from a build that was checked against the PDF. Full check with e2e on the uncommitted branch on top of efefad3, with PREVIEW_CHECK_ENABLED off as in production. The assistant container ran the #21964 code, as in the last baseline. All four builds finished with success, and the new e2e item scored 1.0 on every structural score. The spec item scored 1.0 on spec_parses and spec_label_coverage, and 1.02 on spec_field_count. No behavior fails, and seven have new outputs with the same scores. Studio's preview did not load the app, so build.pages-render and build.entry-page-renders have no score and the run is adopted with --force. The judge is gpt-6.1-sol.
